name: -GENERAL SETTINGS-
description: General scoring options that apply to all systems

name: Scoring System:
description: Which scoring system to use

name: Enable Scoring Debug Output
description: Enable debug output for the active scoring system

name: Replace Score Text
description:
Replace Psych Engine's default score text updates.
If disabled, the custom scoring system will still calculate scores and accuracy
but won't update the score text on screen.

name: Show Timing Display
description:
Show timing feedback in milliseconds when hitting notes
Color-coded based on the selected scoring system's judgement tiers

name: Show Judgement Counter
description:
Show a real-time judgement counter displaying hit accuracy statistics
Automatically uses labels from the active scoring system

name: Show Score Comparison
description:
Show multiple scoring systems at the same time
Useful for comparing accuracy and score across systems

Affects performance: Enabling more scoring systems will increase CPU usage

name: Use Kade Engine Style
description: Use Kade Engine style score text formatting instead of Psych Engine style

name: Custom Rating Popups
description:
Replace Psych Engine's default rating popups (sick/good/bad/shit)
with sprites matching the active scoring system's judgement tiers.

Requires images in: images/ratings/[system]/[judgement].png

name: Use Theme Defaults
description:
Use theme.json values for rating popup scale and antialiasing
instead of the settings below.

When enabled, scale and antialiasing are read from:
images/ratings/[system]/theme.json

name: Rating Popup Scale
description:
Scale multiplier for custom rating popups.
1.0 = default size, 0.5 = half, 2.0 = double

name: Rating Popup Antialiasing
description:
Antialiasing mode for custom rating popups.

ClientPrefs: Uses your game's antialiasing setting
On: Always enabled
Off: Always disabled

name: Rating Popup Framerate
description:
Animation framerate for spritesheet rating popups.
Only affects animated popups (not individual images).

name: Rating Popup Fade Duration
description:
Duration in seconds for the rating popup fade-out tween.

0.1 = Default
0.2 = Psych Engine Default

name: Rating Popup Velocity X
description:
Horizontal velocity of rating popup sprites.
Negative = left, Positive = right.
0 = Default
10 = Psych Engine default

name: Rating Popup Velocity Y
description:
Vertical velocity of rating popup sprites.
Negative = upward, Positive = downward.
-70 = Default
-140 = Psych Engine default

name: Lock Popup to Strum
description:
Lock rating popup position to the player's strum line
instead of the default center-left placement.

When enabled, popups appear centered on the first player strum.
Combo offset is ignored when this is on.

name: -JUDGEMENT COUNTER SETTINGS-
description: Position and color settings for the judgement counter

name: Counter X Position:
description: Horizontal position of the judgement counter on screen

name: Counter Y Position:
description: Vertical position of the judgement counter on screen

name: Override Tier Colors
description:
Override the default tier colors with custom FlxColor presets.
When disabled, uses the scoring system's default colors.

name: Tier 1 Color:
description: Color for the highest tier judgment (e.g. Sick, Marvelous, MAX, Flawless)

name: Tier 2 Color:
description: Color for the second tier judgment (e.g. Good, Perfect, 300, Precise)

name: Tier 3 Color:
description: Color for the third tier judgment (e.g. Bad, Great, 200)

name: Tier 4 Color:
description: Color for the fourth tier judgment (e.g. Shit, Good, 100)

name: Tier 5 Color:
description:
Color for the fifth tier judgment (e.g. 50, Way Off, Ok)
Only used by systems with 5+ hit tiers

name: Tier 6 Color:
description:
Color for the sixth tier judgment (e.g. Sloppy)
Only used by Ruthless

name: Tier 7 Color:
description:
Color for the seventh tier judgment (e.g. Barely)
Only used by Ruthless

name: Miss Color:
description: Color for the Miss judgment

name: -WIFE3 SETTINGS-
description: Settings specific to the Wife3 (Etterna) scoring system

name: Judge Preset:
description:
Select timing difficulty preset:
J1 = Easiest (88ms Marvelous window)
J4 = Default (22ms Marvelous window)
J9 = Hardest/JUSTICE (8.8ms Marvelous window)

Lower numbers = easier timing
Higher numbers = stricter timing

name: Judge Scale (Advanced):
description:
Custom timing window scale (overrides preset if set)
4.0 = J1 (88ms), 1.0 = J4 (22ms), 0.4 = J9 (8.8ms)

Example: 0.7 = J4.5 (15.4ms)

Higher values = easier timing
Lower values = stricter timing

Leave at default to use Judge Preset instead

name: -OSU!MANIA SETTINGS-
description: Settings specific to the osu!mania scoring system (V1 and V2)

name: Overall Difficulty (OD):
description:
osu!mania Overall Difficulty (0-10)
Controls timing window strictness:

OD 0: 300=64ms
OD 5: 300=49ms
OD 8: 300=40ms (default)
OD 10: 300=34ms

MAX window is always 16ms regardless of OD.
Higher OD = stricter timing windows.

name: -ITG SETTINGS-
description: Settings specific to the ITG scoring system

name: ITG Window Scale:
description:
Timing window scale multiplier
Controls timing window strictness:

1.0 = Default ITG windows (22.5ms Fantastic)
0.5 = Half windows (11.25ms Fantastic)
2.0 = Double windows (45ms Fantastic)

Lower values = stricter timing
Higher values = more lenient timing

name: -RUTHLESS SETTINGS-
description: Settings specific to the Ruthless scoring system

name: Perfect Window (ms):
description:
Maximum timing offset for a 100% scored hit.
Hits beyond this window use linear curve down to 0%.

0ms = Only frame-perfect hits score 100%
10ms = Default (strict but achievable)
15ms = Most lenient setting

name: -O2JAM SETTINGS-
description: Settings specific to the O2Jam scoring system

name: BPM-Based Windows
description:
Use BPM-based timing windows instead of fixed windows.
Authentic O2Jam behavior where timing difficulty scales with BPM.

BPM windows (tick-based):
  COOL = 7500/BPM ms (6 ticks)
  GOOD = 22500/BPM ms (18 ticks)
  BAD = 31250/BPM ms (25 ticks)

Fixed windows (default):
  COOL = 33ms, GOOD = 67ms, BAD = 100ms

Example at 150 BPM: COOL=50ms, GOOD=150ms, BAD=208ms
Example at 200 BPM: COOL=37.5ms, GOOD=112.5ms, BAD=156ms

name: -QUAVER SETTINGS-
description: Settings specific to the Quaver scoring system

name: Judgement Difficulty:
description: Quaver timing difficulty preset.

description: Show osu!mania V2 in the Score Comparison panel
